home.headline: Create Your AI Fashion Look
home.body: Upload a full body photo, choose a pose, style your outfit, and create a personal fashion editorial — all in one simple flow.
home.steps: Upload, pose, outfit, background, and your own AI fashion look.
home.uploadDetail: Start with one full body photo.
home.curateDetail: Select a pose, outfit, and scene.

studio.intro: Compose a personal fashion editorial in a few considered steps.
studio.photoHint: Use a clear, full-body image. Your photo remains in this private browser session and you can begin without creating an account.

history.title: Your saved looks
history.body: A private archive, kept in this browser for your own look sessions.

result.body: This look uses product-specific material, construction, fit, and silhouette data to protect the original design.
result.unavailable: No purchase link is available for this item.
result.locked: Product construction is locked by default. These controls only request rendering adjustments while the provider preserves product fabric, length, width, neckline, sleeves, color, and details.

products.title: Product Manager
products.body: Upload real LESOUL product images and build your private lookbook.
products.name: Product Name

measurements.title: Body Measurements
measurements.subtitle: Enter measurements for a more accurate fit.
measurements.privacy: Saved only in this browser for your private fit profile.
measurements.error: Please check the highlighted measurement ranges.

photoValidation.required: Upload a full-body photo to continue.
photoValidation.too_wide: Please upload a full-body photo. Use a vertically long image and step back a little.
photoValidation.too_narrow: Photo ratio is incorrect. Please upload a normally proportioned full-body image.

generationProgress.moment: AI is creating your look. This may take a moment.
generationProgress.long: Generation is taking longer than expected. Your request remains safely in progress.
generationProgress.stillWorking: Your original request is still in progress, so no duplicate was created.
generationProgress.retrying: The prior request finished without a result. Creating a new retry now.
generationProgress.note: Your selected LESOUL look is being prepared with care.

handPocket.title: Hand in Pocket
handPocket.description: A relaxed hand-in-pocket stance for effortless everyday styling.

side.title: Soft Side Angle
side.description: A gentle side angle to review silhouette and garment length.

front.title: Front View
front.description: A straight-on editorial view for balanced proportions.

walking.title: Walking
walking.description: A natural stride to review movement and drape.

crossedArms.title: Crossed Arms
crossedArms.description: A confident crossed-arm stance with a polished mood.

seated.title: Seated
seated.description: A seated composition to review waist and sleeve proportions.

standing.title: Natural Standing
standing.description: A clear, relaxed full-body product view.

elegant.title: Elegant Fashion
elegant.description: An elongated editorial line for a polished fashion result.

catalogUi.testPoseBody: Choose a titled 2D pose for a predictable composition.
catalogUi.sceneBody: Each title opens a distinct illustrated setting for your fashion editorial.
catalogUi.secureComposite: Your photo and selected product references are sent securely for an AI fashion composite.
catalogUi.testModelBody: Preloaded full-body fashion model for a predictable composite check.
catalogUi.testFlow: HANA + test pose + catalog look + studio background
catalogUi.chooseLook: Choose an AI Stylist look, a random look, or products manually.
catalogUi.catalogLoading: The test catalog is loading. Please try again in a moment.

productManager.primaryImageBody: Use one clear front product image. It is the reference used for styling and try-on.
productManager.csvColumns: Use columns: name, category, color, season, style, fabric, texture, fit, length, width, details, neckline, sleeve, price, purchaseUrl, purchasePlatform. Price must be in CNY.
productManager.metadataBody: Manual tags use the same structure reserved for future Vision analysis.
productManager.mainReference: One primary front image is used as the product reference. Side, detail, and preview studio-cut slots are not used.
productManager.imageRequired: Upload a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 8MB.
productManager.uploadError: Unable to upload image. Please try again.
productManager.localizedContentBody: Enter a source name and description, then generate the other two languages. You can edit every field before saving.
productManager.discountSeasonBody: Set the discount ladder for 1, 2, 3, and 4+ items.
productManager.momentCouponBody: Show a limited coupon for an additional discount after the tier discount.
